name: blip
description: P2P LAN messenger — text, voice, and video. No cloud, no servers, no accounts.

scripts.prebuild: npm run typecheck && npm run copy-fonts && node scripts/sync-app-metadata.mjs && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs
scripts.postinstall: npm run copy-fonts && npm run typecheck
scripts.electron:dev: npm run typecheck && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node scripts/electron-dev.mjs"
scripts.electron:dev:peer2: npm run typecheck && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node scripts/electron-dev-peer2.mjs"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win nsis
scripts.electron:build:portable: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win portable
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/publish-mac.mjs
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux
scripts.electron:publish:win: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --publish always
scripts.electron:publish:mac: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/publish-mac.mjs --publish
scripts.electron:publish:linux: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --publish always
scripts.electron:build:dir: npm run build && node scripts/sync-giphy-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-mesh-public-key.mjs && node scripts/sync-build-info.mjs && npm run build:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --dir
